description: Convert hand circumference (inches or cm) to men's and women's glove sizes with the real fitted-glove tables.

faqs.a: Measure around the widest part of your hand (the knuckles), excluding the thumb, with a soft tape. Men's glove size = this circumference in inches, rounded.
faqs.q: How do I measure my hand?

faqs.a: Men's sizes run 7 (XS) to 12 (XXL) in whole inches; women's run 6.5 to 9 in half-inches. The tool picks the right table by fit.
faqs.q: Do men's and women's sizes differ?

faqs.a: Glove length is measured from the tip of the middle finger to the base of the palm (the first wrist crease). Length tables vary by brand, so circumference is the primary sizing measure here.

howto: Enter your hand circumference in inches or centimetres.
Read the nearest glove size in letter and numeric form, plus the full table.
